title: Traffic Volume Count Locations Active in Minnesota
description: The ACTIVE traffic count locations in Minnesota are aligned on an ongoing basis with road centerlines as published from the MnDOT LRS. Traffic count data has been collected at these locations in various years via several methods. This count information is used to determine annual average daily traffic (AADT). Please note that updates to this dataset are always underway, therefore the data may not match ground conditions and in some places may be missing. Resource Contact: Traffic Forecasting & Analysis (TFA), https://www.dot.state.mn.us/tda/contacts.html#TFA
snippet: Display the location of ACTIVE traffic count locations within the state of Minnesota on roadways where data is collected for the determination of annual average daily traffic (AADT).
